ai.title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B Open Multimodal Agent Model
ai.brief: 5 Super VL , an open vision-language model built for always-on enterprise agents. 5 Super VL is a 120B-parameter mixture-of-experts model from NVIDIA that activates 12B parameters per token. It reads text, images, documents and video, then reasons, calls tools and writes code in one model. For developers, 1 open checkpoint replaces a separate text model along with a separate vision model. 5 Bolt 74B-A9B and Bolt E4B. TL;DR Size: 120B total parameters, 12B active (MoE). Context up to 1M tokens. Runs on: 1x DGX Spark, 1x H200, 2x H100 or 1x GB200 with the NVFP4 checkpoint. A BF16 checkpoint is also published. Performance: Strong reasoning, agentic coding and document vision. NVIDIA claims up to 5x higher single-GPU throughput than open peers. 90 on GPQA-Diamond (NVFP4). 78 on tau3-bench banking (NVFP4). 5 Super VL? It is an open multimodal agent model. 1 license .

sec.title: Silent Lynx: Kazakhstan-Linked Hackers Target Russian Refinery and Government
sec.brief: S. S. S. CISA adds Ivanti Connect Secure flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog Researchers from Cisco Talos and Recorded Future published a detailed paper on a threat actor they call Silent Lynx (aka UAT-6275, TAG-193), a Kazakhstan nexus group conducting espionage across Central Asia. The targets include the Orsk Oil Refinery in southern Russia, about 25 kilometers from the Kazakhstan border, and the government of Nizhny Novgorod, a major city about 425 kilometers east of Moscow. The city lies where the Volga and Oka rivers meet, an important waterway system connected to the Caspian Sea. This target may be significant because Kazakhstan depends on the Caspian basin. The group has been running targeted intrusion campaigns against government bodies, diplomatic missions and civil society organizations across Central Asia since at least 2024.
